 This unique event combines the rich historical tapestry of Door County with the vibrant local bar scene, offering a one-of-a-kind experience for trivia buffs and party-goers alike. Choose anywhere from 1 hour to 3 hours with different price points, depending on how long you want to engage in this trivia and history tour.

You’ll learn about the founding of Door County, to why there are goats on the roof of Al Johnson’s, and everything in-between. All while enjoying delicious food and beverages, and making new friends!
